services.name: Stand-up Paddleboard
services.desc: Visit Chatham's top destination for Stand-up Paddleboard (SUP) rentals, available for all ages and levels of experience. Whether you prefer to start off in calm Bucks Creek, or on Nantucket Sound, our staff will bring your board right to the water for you - no heavy lifting required. We handle every step of the process so you can focus on exploring the peaceful estuaries, discovering wildlife and becoming a SUP expert. We're proud to provide our customers with quality board rentals, including Bic

blurb: Guests can rent Hobie Getaways, Hobie Waves, Sunfish sailboats, Hobie Kayaks, and stand-up paddleboards for all ages. Rentals include life jackets, rigging, launching and de-rigging services. Expert-led private sailing tours and lessons offer sightseeing and seal spotting opportunities around Cape Cod landmarks and Monomoy Island.
